inline_text:
Adds definitions for six KEEP terms from the taxonomy spreadsheet:

- Agent registry
- Governance
- Autonomy level
- Risk classification
- Kill switch
- Continuous assurance

Fills four existing placeholders and adds Agent registry and Continuous assurance as new entries. Definitions follow the spreadsheet, with wording adjustments and explanatory scope notes.

Continuous assurance uses “approved specification” in place of “approved blueprint” to avoid prescribing an artifact name.

Agent blueprint is deferred pending discussion of Agent Manifest.

Intended purpose is deferred pending resolution of its overlap with Intent in #65.
